title: 124. Divine Mercy - Rejoicing in What Jesus Rejoices in!

reels.title: I Thought a Religious Podcast Would Destroy Me
reels.hook: He Feared Faith Would Destroy His Career
reels.why: A personal and concrete confession of an entrepreneur who was afraid that clients would Google him and call him a fanatic. It has fear, resistance, and a clear point about obedience.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: It is enough for God that you obey.

cards.text: He Feared Faith Would Destroy His Career
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
As a business consultant, he hesitated whether to start a religious podcast.
Moving to Međugorje
“It is enough for God that you obey.”
Divine Mercy – Rejoicing in What Jesus Rejoices in!

reels.title: Test of Faith: Do You Rejoice in Another's Success for Jesus?
reels.hook: One Question That Reveals Your Faith
reels.why: Gives the viewer a simple and personal test that can immediately be applied to oneself. The question directly called out the viewer.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Blessed are all those who rejoice in what God rejoices in.

cards.text: One Question That Reveals Your Faith
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
Interpretation of the Epistle to the Philippians, in which Saint Paul rejoices when others proclaim Christ.
“Do you rejoice when someone else spreads the name of Jesus?”
“Blessed are all those who rejoice in what God rejoices in.”
Divine Mercy – Rejoicing in What Jesus Rejoices in!

reels.title: Paul to Macedonia: Without a Plane Ticket and Travel Insurance
reels.hook: Without a Plane, Without Insurance, with Wild Beasts
reels.why: A vivid picture of Saint Paul's journey, contrasted with today's airplanes and travel insurance. From this comes a clear message about what faith is.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: There is no travel insurance, and dangers at every step.

cards.text: Without a Plane, Without Insurance, with Wild Beasts
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
The Journey of Saint Paul
On foot and slowly
Paul set out on the journey because God called him in a dream.
“There is no travel insurance, and dangers at every step.”
Divine Mercy – Rejoicing in What Jesus Rejoices in!

reels.title: God Chooses for Great Deeds Those Who Do Not Want It
reels.hook: You Don't Want to Do It? Maybe That's Exactly Why
reels.why: An unexpected turn: the call comes precisely to those who do not seek it. The thought comes full circle, from the last place at the table to “Everything falls into place”.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: God chooses for great deeds those who do not want it.

cards.text: You Don't Want to Do It? Maybe That's Exactly Why
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
Interpretation of the Gospel (Lk 14) about the guests who choose the first places at the table.
“God chooses for great deeds those who do not want it.”
Divine Mercy – Rejoicing in What Jesus Rejoices in!

reels.title: Whoever Waits Patiently with the Lord, Receives Their Opportunity
reels.hook: Stuck in a Lower Position? This Is the Reason
reels.why: A comforting and practical insight for anyone who feels undervalued. Ends with a strong quote from a Psalm and a prayer of surrender.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Whoever waits patiently with the Lord, receives their opportunity.

cards.text: Stuck in a Lower Position? This Is the Reason
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
Interpretation of the Gospel: whoever humbles himself will be exalted.
“Whoever waits patiently with the Lord, receives their opportunity.”
“Unless the Lord builds the house, in vain do the builders labor.”
Divine Mercy – Rejoicing in What Jesus Rejoices in!

reels.title: Results Are Your Best Friend, in Faith Too
reels.hook: They Don't Like the Coach, but Nobody Touches Him. Why?
reels.why: A short and clear comparison from business and sports that everyone understands, applied to evangelization. It has a solid beginning and end.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar

cards.text: They Don't Like the Coach, but Nobody Touches Him. Why?
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
“Nobody can go against results.”
The same applies in business, sports, politics, and evangelization.
Divine Mercy – Rejoicing in What Jesus Rejoices in!

reels.title: Christianity Is Declining in Western Europe, and Jesus Is Sad
reels.hook: Generations Gave Their Lives for This. We Are Losing It
reels.why: A strong and somewhat provocative claim about the decline of Christianity in the West evokes emotion and encourages comments.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: So many gave their life so that Christianity would spread.

cards.text: Generations Gave Their Lives for This. We Are Losing It
Vladimir Grebenar, host of Ora et Labora
Saint Paul in the Epistle to the Philippians writes that he rejoices when Christ is proclaimed.
Where Christianity Is Declining
